newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end firmer, seen targetting 1,280.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end firmer, seen targetting 1,280.

text.p: Austrian shares climbed nearly 1.5 percent on Monday and traders predicted the ATX index could power ahead to test 1,280 points in the coming days.
The ATX index jumped 1.48 percent or 18.40 points to 1,259.44. Among its constituents 17 shares rose, three fell and was one unchanged.
The index hit an intraday high of 1,260.30 points, just short of its life high of 1,261.16 of March 11 this year.
"The market is technically driven," said one trader. "We're now looking the high in the face."

Dealers said demand was strong in cyclical stocks such as high-grade steelmaker Boehler, oil and chemicals group OMV, steelmaker VA Stahl, engineering group VA Tech and fireproof material maker Radex Heraklith which all hit new year highs.
"We will see tomorrow if there is stronger resistance at this level," said one trader. "That would be actually logical at an all time high."
Traders said a lot would depend on what happens with the expiry of May futures and options on Friday. Broad demand pointed to further gains, another dealer said.
"If we go through 1,260 points quickly then we could see 1,300 by Friday," he noted.
The top gainer was Radex RHIV, adding 4.51 percent to 533 schillings.
Fibremaker Lenzing led the decliners, dropping 0.42 percent to 704 schillings.
The May ATX contract gained 19.10 points to 1,259.0.
